title: Seed production locomotion shell state at request boundary

observed_failure.root_cause: BridgeShellState is initialized only during movement application, while TryOpen requires it before movement can begin

hypothesis: TryOpen can seed an uninitialized BridgeShellState from the current production actor transform while still in BalanceActive_Standing, after which the unchanged gate can validate shell authority and open locomotion without enabling CharacterMovement, capsule collision, or explicit transition lock mode.
single_behavior_change: Initialize BridgeShellState at the locomotion request boundary when the owner actor exists and runtime state is BalanceActive_Standing.
tdd_contract: EvaluateStage2ALocomotionRequestGate remains Denied_ShellRootUnlocked for an uninitialized shell state.
TryOpen from a real owned component in BalanceActive_Standing seeds LastAcceptedActorLocation, sets bInitialized=true, and succeeds.
TryOpen cannot seed without an owner or outside BalanceActive_Standing.
Seeding does not move or rotate the actor and does not change CMC/capsule state.
next_if_supported: Rerun E60 Normal-1 and classify the first physical locomotion trajectory.
